HSIM Card Maker

The Clarity Seminar · Card Maker

Type the names, check the preview, download. The design stays exactly as approved.

1 · Which card?
Example names are filled in. Replace them with your list. You can paste a column straight from Google Sheets or Excel. Long names shrink to fit.
Entry pass
Names are optional for the entry pass. Leave the names box empty to get one blank pass (front + back) that the counselor fills by hand.
Numbers run on their own: 001, 002, 003 … After a download the box moves to the next free number, for everyone on the team. To give someone a fixed number, write it after the name with a comma, for example Riya Sharma, 014.
3 · Download
The name follows the card in the preview. Send the card image first, then paste this message.
Event details on the cards
These come from one place, so every card stays the same. To change them, send a change request below.

Request a changeChoose the card, write what should change (time, text, anything), and send. Then tell Claude in chat: "card requests dekh lo".
